'''Lyron''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] fellow Duros [[Teo Gronn]] as their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="OTF" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> they participated in a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] sent to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Lyron [[Death/Legends|perished]] in the fighting<ref name="OTF" /> when the rescue mission became a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|bloody battle]] that sparked the inter-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Oshi-Jid]] became the new master of Gronn but was presumed to be killed<ref name="OTF" /> only four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the start of the war<ref name="TNEC" /> in the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].<ref name="OTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lyron was mentioned in ''[[Only the Force]]'', a [[2004]] stand-alone [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and released by the [[Wikipedia:RPGA|RPGA]] on behalf of [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="OTF" />
